available_features: MoneyPuck xG for/against (50) and recent xG differential (10)
planned_features: verified starting goalies and historical pregame goalie GSAx
warnings: Experimental ML candidate has not demonstrated superiority to the goals/rest-only baseline; no automatic model promotion.
Model probabilities are provisional estimates, not guaranteed win rates.
No market prices supplied: expected value is not evaluated.
Totals follow unchanged V1 official final-score convention; verify market overtime/shootout settlement rules.
Combinations exclude started games. Same-game selections have bounds only; do not multiply their probabilities.
sources: MoneyPuck.com team game-by-game xG (credited; non-commercial use)

holdout_validation.promotion_warning: Richer ML model does not beat the goals/rest-only baseline. Do not treat feature complexity as evidence of better forecasts.
limitations: Single untouched season holdout; no market-price or profitability test.
MoneyPuck historical xG is a current retrospective snapshot, not point-in-time archived xG.
Goalies, injuries and travel are not model inputs. Home advantage is learned by the intercept.
